question:
The following sentence contains a word with a spelling error. Rectify the sentence by selecting the correct spelling of the identified word from the given options.

Later on, he was truely apologetic for his misconduct in the meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"truely"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"truly"**. (सच में)
 
 
• **Example: **He truly regretted his actions after the meeting.
 
 

 
• **"Truly"** refers to something that is genuine, sincere, or real. (वास्तव में)
 
 
• **Example: **She is truly dedicated to her work.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Trooly** (गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling.
 
 
• **Truily** (गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling.
 
 
• **Treuly** (गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling.
